messages:
Diego - Eng Manager: Hey @people-ops — quick scenario: Jin shipped a big infra change while on my team, transferred mid-window, and is asking for the leveling move mid-cycle. Transfer paperwork finished 2026-11-02. Can old-team evidence count?
Nora - People Ops: Short answer: yes, with both managers' sign-offs and a clear ownership blurb. Mark packet as 'mid-cycle transfer' so calibration chairs flag it.
Jin - IC: Context: led the rollout that reduced p99 by 28% and removed a legacy service. Most work done on Diego's team until 11/01. Happy to provide PR links and dashboards.
Diego - Eng Manager: I'll draft the evidence. Do we need a special template for mid-cycle transfers?
Nora - People Ops: Use this minimal template in the packet: one-paragraph summary, dates, impact metrics, links to PRs/dashboards, old + new manager endorsements, and suggested effective date. Keep it tight.
Priya - Comp: Note on routing: if this is purely band alignment (same band mapping) we can fast-track. If role maps differently across orgs -> leveling-exception form required and comp + calibration review needed.
Marta - Payroll: Operational deadlines: comp approvals in our system by 2026-11-10 23:59 UTC to hit the next pay. Payroll file submit by 2026-11-13 18:00 PT. Missed submit = retro processed next cycle. Include employee EID in the packet.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: International hires require Employment Ops review. Flag country in packet. Link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/leveling-exceptions
Jin - IC: I'm in APAC (Singapore). Any extra steps?
Nora - People Ops: For SG, Employment Ops needs to confirm tax withholdings and any local paperwork. That can add 3-7 business days. If international, start Employment Ops ASAP and note potential delay in the packet.
Diego - Eng Manager: If calibration denies the level move, what fallback options do we have to recognize Jin now?
Priya - Comp: Typical fallbacks: spot bonus (one-time) or off-cycle base increase. Spot bonuses don't change base; off-cycle increases require comp+headcount confirmation and may need CFO sign-off if above threshold. For spot amounts >5% comp approval required.
Marta - Payroll: Spot payout flow: manager rationale + people-ops sign-off, comp approval if >5%, payroll form entry before payroll deadline. Retro handling as described.
Nora - People Ops: If you want us to consider a bridge, include a recommended fallback in the packet (e.g., 6% spot fallback) so comp can pre-approve during calibration. Saves cycles.
Diego - Eng Manager: Good call. I'll prepare the pack with both manager endorsements and a fallback suggestion. Ping me if you need a pre-check.
Onboarding Bot: Action logged: packet_started by Diego. Calibration meeting: Tue 9am PT. Submit items 48h prior for guaranteed review.
Nora - People Ops: Thanks — once submitted I'll do a pre-check and loop Employment Ops for SG. Thread closed pending submission.
